mapper.select: /* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmList */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_ALGRM A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getDtPreprocLastFile */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_FILES WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etcModelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getModelAlgorithmParamsList */ SELECT A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ, A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_TP, A.MODEL_PARAMS_DERPN, B.ETC_MODEL_SEQ, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM, B.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_VALUE, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_CRTR_1, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_CRTR_2, (SELECT T.MODEL_ALGRM FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_ALGRM T WHERE A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = T.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y') MODEL_ALGRM_NM FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_ITEM A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_META_ETC_MODEL_PARAMS B ON A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = B.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ AND B.ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} WHERE A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = #{model_algrm_seq} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDBY

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgorithmModelParamsCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_PARAMS A JOIN TB_META_ETC_MODEL B ON A.ETC_MODEL_SEQ = B.ETC_MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.ETC_MODEL_SEQ = B.ETC_MODEL_SEQ AND B.ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etcModelSeq}
/* file : AIModelMapper.xml, id : getModelLoss */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_LOSS WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etcModelSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EPOCHS_CNT
/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getUnitCodeList */ SELECT * FROM TB_UNIT A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmCodeList */ SELECT DTL_CD , DTL_CD_NM , REF_CD , REF_CLASS , REF_VALUE , ORDBY FROM TB_CODE_DTL WHERE GRP_CD = #{grp_cd} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDBY, DTL_CD_NM

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getEtcModelList */ SELECT ETC_MODEL_SEQ, ETC_MODEL_NM, TRGT_COL, ETC_MODEL_TP, (SELECT MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_VALUE FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_PARAMS WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = A.ETC_MODEL_SEQ AND MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = 1 AND MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = 1) WINDOW_SIZE, A.REG_USER_SEQ, A.RLS_YN FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL A WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' /*나의 유효성 검증 모델 + 공유된 유효성 검증 모델*/ AND (REG_USER_SEQ = #{session_userseq} OR RLS_YN = 'Y') AND MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = 1 AND MODEL_STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC;

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getEtcModelList */ SELECT ETC_MODEL_SEQ, ETC_MODEL_NM, TRGT_COL, ETC_MODEL_TP FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL A WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND (REG_USER_SEQ = #{session_userseq} OR RLS_YN = 'Y') AND MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = 2 AND MODEL_STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC;

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getEtcModelList */ SELECT ETC_MODEL_SEQ, ETC_MODEL_NM, TRGT_COL, ETC_MODEL_TP FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL A WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND (REG_USER_SEQ = #{session_userseq} OR RLS_YN = 'Y') AND MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = 3 AND MODEL_STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC;

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getEtcModelList */ SELECT ETC_MODEL_SEQ, ETC_MODEL_NM, TRGT_COL, ETC_MODEL_TP FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL A WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND (REG_USER_SEQ = #{session_userseq} OR RLS_YN = 'Y') AND MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = 4 AND MODEL_STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC;
mapper.update: update TB_META_ETC_MODEL set USE_YN= 'N', DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_USER_SEQ = #{user_seq}, DEL_DT = now(), DEL_IP = #{user_ip} where ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq}
update TB_META_ETC_MODEL_FILES set USE_YN= 'N', DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_USER_SEQ = #{user_seq}, DEL_DT = now(), DEL_IP = #{user_ip} where ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq}
update TB_META_ETC_MODEL_COLUMN set USE_YN= 'N', DEL_YN = 'Y' where ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq}
update TB_META_ETC_MODEL_LOSS set USE_YN= 'N', DEL_YN = 'Y' where ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq}
update TB_META_ETC_MODEL_PARAMS set USE_YN= 'N', DEL_YN = 'Y' where ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq}
